note: Real screenshots captured from the running erpmedsupply Odoo 18 with the Spiffy backend theme. EN images in docs/manual/img/en/<file>, Arabic UI versions in docs/manual/img/ar/<file>. Reference a figure by its <file> name. Each entry: what the screenshot actually shows.

figures.login.png: The sign-in screen for the erpmedsupply database: email/login and password fields and a Log in button.
figures.apps_home.png: The Spiffy app launcher (opened from the 9-dot grid icon): a search box and large app icons for Discuss, Contacts, Sales, Dashboards, Accounting, Purchase, Inventory, Apps and Settings.
figures.settings_general.png: The General Settings page (Settings app) with feature switches grouped by section.
figures.company.png: The Company form (Sudan MedSupply Co.): legal name, address (Khartoum, Sudan), phone/email, tax id and currency.
figures.currencies_list.png: The Currencies list under Accounting Configuration, showing active currencies including SDG and USD.
figures.currency_usd.png: The USD currency record with the Rates tab open, showing the dated exchange-rate history (1 USD = 2,400 -> 4,500 SDG across 2025-2026).
figures.contacts_list.png: The Contacts directory (kanban/list) listing customers and suppliers together, e.g. Khartoum Teaching Hospital, Gulf MedTrade.
figures.contact_customer.png: The contact form for Khartoum Teaching Hospital (a Company-type customer): name, address, phone, email; the General Information area.
figures.contact_customer_salespurchase.png: The Sales & Purchase tab of the Khartoum Teaching Hospital contact: customer pricelist, payment terms, salesperson, purchase currency, etc.
figures.contact_customer_accounting.png: The Accounting tab of the contact: receivable/payable accounts, bank accounts and fiscal information.
figures.contact_supplier.png: The contact form for Gulf MedTrade FZE (USD), a foreign supplier in Dubai whose purchase currency is USD.
figures.warehouses.png: The Warehouses list under Inventory Configuration: Khartoum Central Warehouse (KRT) and Port Sudan Warehouse (PRT).
figures.locations_list.png: The Locations list showing internal sub-locations under KRT/Stock: Cold Storage (2-8C), Quarantine, Expired / Damaged.
figures.uom_list.png: The Units of Measure list grouped by category (Unit, Weight, Volume, etc.).
figures.categories_list.png: The Product Categories list: Pharmaceuticals, Medical Consumables, Medical Devices (FIFO costing, FEFO removal).
figures.journals_list.png: The Journals list under Accounting Configuration: Customer Invoices, Vendor Bills, Bank of Khartoum (SDG), USD Bank Account, Main Cash Safe (SDG), USD Cash Safe, Miscellaneous.
figures.journal_bank.png: The Bank of Khartoum (SDG) bank journal form: journal type, bank account number and accounting settings.
figures.chart_of_accounts.png: The Chart of Accounts list (generic chart) with account codes, names and types.
figures.taxes_list.png: The Taxes list showing the 15% sale and 15% purchase taxes (Sudan).
figures.products_list.png: The product catalogue (Products) with the 10 medical items, their internal references and on-hand quantities.
figures.product_insulin.png: The product form for Insulin Vial 10ml (General Information tab): product type, category, cost, sales price, internal reference; with On Hand / Forecasted / Reordering smart buttons.
figures.product_insulin_inventory.png: The Inventory tab of the Insulin product: Routes (Buy), Logistics (responsible, weight, volume, customer lead time), Traceability (Expiration Date on), and Dates (Expiration 365 days after receipt, Best Before, Removal, Alert).
figures.product_insulin_purchase.png: The Purchase tab of the Insulin product: the vendor pricelist line (Gulf MedTrade, 14.00 USD, lead time) and purchase control settings.
figures.lots_list.png: The Lots/Serial Numbers list: batches such as LOT-GULF-01, LOT-NILE-01 with their products and expiration dates.
figures.lot_insulin.png: The lot form for LOT-GULF-01 (Insulin): lot number, product, on-hand quantity and expiration date.
figures.reordering_rules.png: The Reordering Rules list: minimum/maximum levels for Paracetamol (50/200), Insulin (20/80) and Gloves (30/120).
figures.onhand_quants.png: The On Hand / Current Stock view (quants) showing product, location and on-hand quantity, including items in Cold Storage.
figures.inventory_overview.png: The Inventory app Operations overview: cards for Receipts, Delivery Orders, Internal Transfers etc., each with a count of work to process.
figures.transfers_all.png: The Transfers list (all operation types) with status badges (Done, Ready, Waiting).
figures.receipt_form.png: A validated goods Receipt form from a purchase order, showing operations, source/destination locations, the product moves and the assigned lot numbers.
figures.delivery_form.png: A validated Delivery order form from a sales order, showing the picked products and the lots reserved under FEFO.
figures.purchase_orders.png: The Purchase Orders list with orders P00001-P00004, vendors, totals and statuses (RFQ/Purchase Order).
figures.po_usd.png: Purchase Order P00002 for Gulf MedTrade (USD): lines for 50 Insulin @ $14 and 10 BP Monitors @ $42, status bar RFQ -> Purchase Order, total $1,288.00 with the SDG equivalent (5,796,000 SDG) shown beneath, and header buttons Create Bill / Receipt.
figures.rfq_list.png: The Requests for Quotation list (draft purchase orders).
figures.po_rfq.png: A draft RFQ (P00004) for Nile Medical Supplies, before confirmation, with the Confirm Order button.
figures.quotations_list.png: The Quotations list in Sales (draft and sent quotations).
figures.sale_orders_list.png: The Sales Orders list: S00001, S00002 (confirmed) and totals in SDG.
figures.sale_order.png: Sales Order S00001 for Khartoum Teaching Hospital: order lines (Paracetamol, Gloves, Syringes) priced in SDG, status bar Quotation -> Sales Order, smart buttons (Delivery, Invoice) and total 2,038,950 SDG.
figures.sale_quotation_draft.png: A draft quotation (S00003) for the Sudanese Red Crescent, showing the Confirm button and the quotation lifecycle.
figures.customer_invoices_list.png: The Customer Invoices list: INV/2026/00001-00005 with customers, amounts, due dates and payment status (Paid / Not Paid).
figures.customer_invoice.png: Posted customer invoice INV/2026/00001 (Khartoum Teaching Hospital) in SDG: invoice lines, 15% tax, total 2,038,950 SDG, status Posted and a green Paid banner; header buttons Register Payment / Credit Note.
figures.customer_invoice_overdue.png: A posted but unpaid (overdue) customer invoice showing the due date and Register Payment button, used by aged-receivable reporting.
figures.vendor_bills_list.png: The Vendor Bills list including BILL/2026/05/0001 (SDG) and BILL/2026/05/0002 (USD) with amounts and payment status.
figures.vendor_bill_usd.png: The USD vendor bill BILL/2026/05/0002 from Gulf MedTrade (483 USD), valued in SDG at the rate on its date.
figures.payments_list.png: The Payments list: customer receipts and a vendor payment, with their journals (Bank of Khartoum, Main Cash Safe) and amounts.
figures.payment_form.png: A customer payment form: partner, amount, payment date, the journal (bank or cash safe) and the linked invoice.
figures.bank_reconcile.png: The bank reconciliation screen (account_reconcile_oca): bank-statement lines on one side to be matched against invoices/payments.
figures.report_balance_sheet.png: The Balance Sheet report options/wizard (accounting_pdf_reports): date and target-move filters before printing.
figures.report_aged_receivable.png: The Aged Receivable report options/wizard: the partner ageing buckets configuration before printing.
figures.users_list.png: The Users list (Settings) showing the demo users: Administrator, Amira (Procurement), Khalid (Sales), Sara (Warehouse), Mohammed (Accountant), Layla (Manager).
figures.user_role.png: The user form for Layla (General Manager) with the Access Rights tab open, showing the application access levels (Sales/Purchase/Inventory Administrator, Accounting Advisor, Settings) that define her role.
figures.accounting_dashboard.png: The Accounting dashboard: cards per journal (Customer Invoices with 3 Unpaid / 2 Late, Vendor Bills 1 To Pay, Bank of Khartoum with a balance and trend chart), each with quick-action buttons.
